description: Advance a paid store order to shipped, fulfilled, or cancel it as its holder. Any member may mark shipped/fulfilled (getting the parcel out is the rikma’s work); cancel is holder-only — the member whose till took the money — because it resets their own self-reported sales not yet in a split; sales already in a split are left and the rikma is told to settle the refund. Idempotent (same status twice succeeds quietly); backwards transitions refuse (§3.4). On cancel, pass restock:true to put the items back on the shelf (default: only when the order was not yet shipped). Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#updateRikmaOrderStatusTool

action.description: shipped → parcel left, fulfilled → delivered/picked up, cancel → refund.

orderRef.description: Order ref (`<rikma>:<externalId>` as POST /orders answered) or orderId.

reason.description: Cancel reason shown on the order and in sale notes.

restock.description: On cancel: put items back in stock. Default: only when not yet shipped.

name: updateRikmaOrderStatusTool
